_about: Test data for the store build. Nothing in here is for sale. The artists are named with their permission still to be asked; every pack title is generic on purpose - no song titles have been invented for anyone. Delete this file the day the store reads from Supabase.

lanes.name: Multitracks
lanes.blurb: Full performances, every instrument on its own fader.

lanes.name: Stems
lanes.blurb: Grouped parts - drums, bass, keys - for a quick mix.

lanes.name: Pads
lanes.blurb: Ambient beds in every key. Sits under anything.

lanes.name: Templates
lanes.blurb: PerformLive sets, ready to open and run.

lanes.name: Click & guide
lanes.blurb: Clicks, counts and spoken cues for the band.

lanes.name: Charts
lanes.blurb: Chord charts and lead sheets, PDF and text.

lanes.name: Bundles
lanes.blurb: Several packs together, priced as one.

creators.name: Kingsley Anyenor
creators.bio: Gospel artist and worship leader. Live sets recorded with his own band, released here as multitracks so any church can run them.

creators.name: Viivi Adjei
creators.bio: Singer and songwriter. Her multitracks come straight from the sessions, with the vocal guide left in so your team can learn the parts.

creators.name: Isaac Narh
creators.bio: Worship artist. Sets built for a full band, with pads and click already in place, so the whole thing opens in PerformLive and just goes.

creators.name: Kwame Asante
creators.bio: Drummer and producer. Highlife and gospel grooves, played by hand, cut into loops that sit right at church tempos.

creators.name: Akosua Mensah
creators.bio: Music director. Builds PerformLive templates and cue packs for teams that have a Sunday to get through and no time to set up.

creators.name: Chinedu Okafor
creators.bio: Producer. Afrobeats and praise-night percussion, and full-band multitracks recorded in his Lagos room.

creators.name: Ama Serwaa Boateng
creators.bio: Choir director and pianist. Hymn pads, charts and arrangements written for real choirs with real ranges.

creators.name: Thabo Mokoena
creators.bio: Bassist and producer. Gospel bass stems, amapiano kits and ready-to-run Sunday templates from Joburg.

items.title: Live Set Multitracks, Vol. 1
items.creator: kingsley-anyenor
items.summary: A full live set from the band, one fader per instrument.
items.description: Every instrument from a live set, on its own track, lined up to the click. Open the set in PerformLive, mute what your band is playing, and run the rest. Vocal guides are included on their own tracks so the team can rehearse with them and drop them on the day.

items.title: Worship Stems Pack
items.creator: kingsley-anyenor
items.summary: The same set, grouped into four stems for a smaller desk.
items.description: Four stems - rhythm, keys and pads, vocals, click - for teams that run from a phone or a small mixer. Same performances as the multitracks, already balanced.

items.title: Live Set Multitracks, Vol. 1
items.creator: viivi-adjei
items.summary: From the session, with the vocal guide left in.
items.description: Eight tracks per song, recorded live. The lead vocal guide is on its own track so a new singer can learn the part and the sound person can pull it on the day.

items.title: Pads & Ambience Kit
items.creator: viivi-adjei
items.summary: The pads from her sets, in all twelve keys.
items.description: Twelve keys, major and minor, each a ten-minute loop with a clean seam. Warm, not bright - made to sit under a sermon or a quiet moment without anyone noticing it is there.

items.title: Live Set Multitracks, Vol. 1
items.creator: isaac-narh
items.summary: Full band, pads and click already placed.
items.description: Opens in PerformLive as a finished set: songs in order, pads under the transitions, click on the count. Mute the band you have, keep the rest.

items.title: Full Set Bundle
items.creator: isaac-narh
items.summary: Multitracks, stems and charts for the whole set, as one.
items.description: Everything for the set in a single purchase: the multitracks, the four-stem version, and chord charts for every song. Cheaper than the three apart.

items.title: Highlife Drum Loops
items.creator: kwame-asante
items.summary: Played by hand. Forty loops, four tempos, tempo-tagged.
items.description: Forty highlife and gospel-highlife grooves, played on a real kit and cut to the bar. Each loop is tagged with its tempo and comes in full, no-kick and hats-only versions.

items.title: Sunday Pads, 12 keys
items.creator: kwame-asante
items.summary: One pad per key. Nothing fancy. Always works.
items.description: A single warm pad in each of the twelve keys, looped clean. This is the one you leave running.

items.title: Worship Set Template
items.creator: akosua-mensah
items.summary: A whole Sunday, laid out. Drop your songs in.
items.description: A PerformLive set with the running order, pad transitions, click routing and cue markers already built. Replace the placeholder songs with yours and the structure holds.

items.title: Click & Cue Pack
items.creator: akosua-mensah
items.summary: Counts, section calls and a click the drummer will not hate.
items.description: Spoken section cues - verse, chorus, bridge, out - recorded clearly and cut to the bar, with a click in three sounds and every common tempo.

items.title: Afrobeats Percussion Kit
items.creator: chinedu-okafor
items.summary: Shakers, congas, log drums and the bits between.
items.description: Sixty percussion loops and two hundred one-shots from a Lagos session. Dry, close, ready for your own room.

items.title: Praise Night Multitracks
items.creator: chinedu-okafor
items.summary: Six high-energy praise arrangements, full band.
items.description: Six praise arrangements recorded with a full band, nine tracks each. Built for the loud part of the service.

items.title: Choir Charts Bundle
items.creator: ama-serwaa-boateng
items.summary: Twenty arrangements, SATB, in ranges a real choir can sing.
items.description: Twenty choir arrangements as PDF and plain text, with parts marked and keys chosen for actual voices rather than for the piano.

items.title: Hymn Pads, warm
items.creator: ama-serwaa-boateng
items.summary: Softer pads, voiced for hymns and quiet services.
items.description: Twelve keys, voiced low and slow so they sit under a hymn without pulling it anywhere modern.

items.title: Gospel Bass Stems
items.creator: thabo-mokoena
items.summary: Bass lines for common progressions, every key, played.
items.description: Real bass over twenty-four common gospel progressions, in every key, at three tempos each. For the team without a bassist this week.

items.title: Amapiano Log Drum Kit
items.creator: thabo-mokoena
items.summary: Log drums, shakers and the swing. Joburg made.
items.description: Fifty log-drum loops and a hundred one-shots at amapiano tempos, with the swing baked in. Clean tails, cut to the bar.

items.title: Ready-to-run Sunday Set
items.creator: thabo-mokoena
items.summary: Open it, load your songs, run the service.
items.description: A PerformLive template with pads, click and cue routing done. Comes with his bass stems already placed under the transitions.

sections.title: From the artists
sections.blurb: Their own sets, on their own faders.

sections.title: Creators
sections.blurb: The people building for your Sunday.
